name: ACCT 4204
title: Financial Statement Analysis and Business Valuation
description: Advances the understanding of financial information to analyze and value firms. Involves the application of accounting, economics, finance and other skills to better understand information contained in financial reports.
requirement_description: Instructor consent; open only to Business majors of junior or higher status; recommended for Honors students. Recommended preparation: ACCT 3202 or BADM 3202.
